name: play-circle
useCase: Start or resume the current process or playback.
misuse: Do not use the play triangle as a page navigation arrow.

16.reason: A compact closed play triangle keeps a visible opening and at least 1px of space to the unchanged circular keyline.

24.reason: The left triangle corners sit slightly farther inside the circle, retaining a large opening and at least 1.5px of space to the keyline.
